workflow_selection_guide.title: Workflow Selection Guide
workflow_selection_guide.content:
# Workflow Selection Guide

## Key Decision Factors

### 1. Scale & Complexity
- **Small workflows**: AWS Step Functions, Azure Logic Apps
- **Medium workflows**: Temporal, Airflow
- **Large distributed systems**: Temporal, custom solutions

### 2. State Management Requirements
- **Simple state**: Step Functions
- **Complex state**: Temporal
- **No state needed**: Simple task queues

### 3. Programming Model
- **Visual/declarative**: Step Functions, Logic Apps
- **Code-first**: Temporal, Airflow
- **Event-driven**: Temporal, EventBridge

### 4. Error Handling Needs
- **Built-in retries**: All major solutions
- **Custom compensation**: Temporal
- **Circuit breakers**: Custom implementations

### 5. Monitoring & Observability
- **Basic**: Step Functions, Airflow
- **Advanced**: Temporal, custom solutions

## Use Case Recommendations

### Data Processing Pipelines
- **Recommended**: Airflow, Temporal
- **When to use**: Batch processing, ETL workflows

### Microservice Orchestration
- **Recommended**: Temporal, Step Functions
- **When to use**: Service coordination, saga patterns

### Human-in-the-loop Workflows
- **Recommended**: Temporal
- **When to use**: Approval processes, manual interventions

### Event Processing
- **Recommended**: Temporal, EventBridge + Step Functions
- **When to use**: Real-time event handling, CQRS

### AI/ML Workflows
- **Recommended**: Temporal, Azure AI Agents, custom
- **When to use**: Model training, inference pipelines

comparison_matrix.title: Workflow Engine Comparison
comparison_matrix.content:
# Workflow Engine Comparison Matrix

| Feature | Temporal | AWS Step Functions | Azure Logic Apps | Airflow | OpenAI Agents |
|---------|----------|-------------------|------------------|---------|---------------|
| **Pricing** | Pay-as-you-go | Per execution + duration | Per action + connector | Infrastructure | API usage |
| **Language Support** | Go, Java, Python, TS | JSON/YAML | JSON/YAML | Python | Python |
| **State Management** | Advanced | Built-in | Built-in | Limited | Limited |
| **Error Handling** | Custom compensation | Built-in | Built-in | Built-in | Custom |
| **Visibility** | Excellent | Good | Good | Good | Limited |
| **Scalability** | Excellent | Excellent | Good | Good | Limited |
| **Learning Curve** | Medium | Low | Low | Medium | High |
| **Ecosystem** | Growing | Mature | Mature | Large | Emerging |
| **Use Cases** | Complex workflows | Simple orchestrations | Enterprise integration | Data pipelines | AI agents |

## When to Choose Each

### Temporal
- Complex business logic
- Long-running workflows
- Custom state management
- Multi-language support needed

### AWS Step Functions
- AWS-native applications
- Visual workflow design
- Simple orchestration needs
- Cost-sensitive small workflows

### Azure Logic Apps
- Enterprise integration
- SaaS connectors
- Low-code requirements
- Microsoft ecosystem

### Airflow
- Data engineering
- ETL/ELT pipelines
- Python ecosystem
- Existing Hadoop/Spark workflows

### OpenAI Agents
- AI-powered workflows
- Multi-agent collaboration
- Natural language interfaces
- Autonomous decision making
